source: 572 The Real Target
target: 572 Meta Vera

source: Under the crimson moonlight, the crew members stumbled towards the dock like the living dead, moving towards the various buildings concealed in the darkness.
target: Sub luce lunari coccinea, nautae titubaverunt ad molam, ut mortui vivos, incedentes ad varia aedificia tenebris celata.

source: In seven to eight minutes, their figures vanished from different spots.
target: In septem ad octo minuta, figurae eorum ex variis locis evanuerunt.

source: Immediately after, Nolfi and Batna observed pitch‐black shapes emerging at the edge of the cabin, and eerie pale‐white or dark‐green flames igniting across the deck.
target: Statim post, Nolfi et Batna conspexerunt formas nigerrimas emergentes ad limitem cubiculi, atque ignes pallide albi vel obscuri viridi in ponte accendentes.

source: Figures crawled out of the pitch‐black flames.
target: Figurae ex ignibus nigerrimis reperebant.

source: Some wore tattered clothes, and their skin visibly rotted.
target: Aliqui vestimenta lacerata gerebant, et cutis eorum manifeste putrida erat.

source: Others were white bones with fragments of flesh hanging from them.
target: Alii erant ossa alba, ex quibus fragmenta carnis pendent.

source: Pale‐white flames protruded from their eye sockets.
target: Flammae pallide albae ex orbibus eorum protulere.

source: These were all corpses!
target: Haec omnes cadavera erant!

source: Soon, a half‐rotted corpse in a dirty jacket hoisted the sail.
target: Mox, cadaver semi putrescens in veste sordida, velum sublevavit.

source: The corpse with a missing breastbone stowed the heavy anchor.
target: Cadaver, cui sternum deesset, gravem ancora condidit.

source: The other corpses took their positions, steering the sailboat slowly away from the port.
target: Ceteri cadavera loca sua ceperunt, navem velariam lente a portu regentes.

source: As they gazed at the decaying flesh, pale‐white bones, and sinister flames of different hues, Batna and Nolfi felt as if they had stepped into a novel world.
target: Dum carnem putrescendam, ossa pallide alba, atque ignes sinistros variis coloribus intuentes erant, Batna et Nolfi quasi in novum orbem intratos se sensere.

source: Horror novels! Ghostly tales!
target: Fabulae horroris! Fabulae umbratæ!

source: “Navigator, it’s time for you to work.”
target: “Navigator, tempus est tibi laborare.”

source: Charname’s voice snapped Nolfi back to reality.
target: Vox Charname Nolfi ad veram realitatem revocavit.

source: In the Governor of the Sea’s residence.
target: In domo Praefecti Maris.

source: Lumian leaned against the statue‐less wall, surveying the other deputy hosts in the hall, including Juan Oro.
target: Lumian in pariete sine statua recubuit, alios hospites vicarii in aula conspiciens, inter quos erat Juan Oro.

source: Uncertain if any of them were genuine, they could easily be impersonated by a Faceless.
target: Nesciens num quisque eorum genuinus esset, facile ab aliquo, qui faciem careret, imitari poterantur.

source: In the upcoming operation, the only person he could unequivocally trust was himself.
target: In operatione futura, sola persona cui sine dubio fidere poterat, ipse erat.

source: An hour passed in an indescribable silence.
target: Hora in silentio ineffabili transiit.

source: This time, Lumian took the initiative, leading Juan Oro into the basement to retrieve the Ring of the Sea Queen, completing the “paying homage to the ancestors” segment.
target: Hoc tempore, Lumian inceptum tulit, ducens Juan Oro in cellam subterraneam ad recuperandum Anulum Reginæ Maris, complens partem "honorem maiorum ferendi."

source: The ring rested on the dilapidated stone platform, untouched.
target: Anulus requiebat super suggestum lapideum dilapidatum, intactus.

source: Lumian couldn’t be certain if it was authentic, but the patterns, symbols, and structure seemed intact, and no one had lurked in the basement after inspection.
target: Lumian certiorem esse non potuit utrum authentica esset, sed figurae, symbola, atque structura intactae videbantur, nec quisquam post inspectionem in cella insidiatus est.

source: Maintaining his calm demeanor and a tense heart, Lumian patiently waited until 6 a.m., feeling both mental and physical fatigue dissipate.
target: Conservans tranquillitatem animi et corde tensum, Lumian patienter exspectavit usque ad 6 mane, sentiens tam mentis quam corporis lassitudinem evanescere.

source: Two hours later, the current Governor of the Sea, Simon, exited the vigil room with four Maidens of the Sea and approached the building’s door.
target: Duo hora post, praefectus Maris hodiernus, Simon, cum quattuor puellārum Maris ex conclavi vigiliae exiit et ad ianuam aedificii accessit.

source: Lumian, Juan Oro, and the other deputy hosts promptly stood up and followed.
target: Lumian, Juan Oro, et ceteri hospites vicarii mox surrexerunt et accesserunt.

source: The two‐story sailboat, adorned with colorful flowers, docked at the Milo Village’s docks.
target: Navis velaria duotabulata, floribus variis ornata, in molibus vici Milo apposita est.

source: Villagers acted as guards, blocking anyone daring to approach.
target: Incolae ut custodes fungebantur, impeditendo quemquam adpropinquare audentem.

source: Ascending the gangway to the deck, Lumian sensed an invisible gaze from every window, flower, and mast—a familiar feeling from when the statues in the Governor of the Sea’s residence came to life.
target: Ascendens ad pontem, Lumian sensit intuitum invisibile ab omni fenestra, flore, et mástre — sensus notus ex tempore quo statuae in domo Praefecti Maris in vitam redierant.

source: He calmly navigated through the gazes, adhering to Juan Oro’s instructions to stand at the left edge of the deck.
target: Tranquillē per intuitus navigavit, iuxta mandata Juan Oro ut ad sinistram partem pontis staret.

source: This was the designated spot for him, the deputy host named Brian.
target: Hoc erat locus destinatus sibi, hospiti vicario nominato Brian.

source: Bang! Bang! Bang!
target: Pum! Pum! Pum!

source: On the dock of Milo Village, vibrant paper fragments burst forth from ceremonial cannons, creating a colorful display.
target: In molibus vici Milo, fragmenta chartacea vibrantia e tormentis caerimoniis erupta sunt, speciem coloribus multiplicibus creantes.

source: Amid the festive atmosphere, the ship set sail gradually.
target: Inter celebratam atmosphaeram, navis paulatim profectus est.

source: It circled Port Santa, capturing the cheers and blessings of the people before venturing toward the distant sea.
target: Circum Portum Santa vecta, laudes et benedictiones populi arripiens, antequam ad mare distante profectus est.

source: As the navigator, Juan Oro guided the ship into a boundless azure sea with no discernible landmarks.
target: Ut navarchus, Juan Oro navem in mare caeruleum immensum sine notabilibus signis duxit.

source: They weaved between left and right turns, occasionally reversing direction.
target: Inter sinistros et dexteros gyris intertexebant, interdum directionem invertentes.

source: Nearly an hour passed, and beneath the clear, bright sky, dense fog suddenly enveloped the ship.
target: Fere una hora pertransiit, et sub caelo claro ac nitido, densus nebula navem subito involvit.

source: Splash!
target: Splash!

source: Within the fog’s depths, waves surged like mountains.
target: In profundis nebulae, undae sicut montes eruperunt.

source: Any ship it touched would capsize or shatter.
target: Quaecumque navis attigeretur, subverteretur aut confringeretur.

source: The Governor of the Sea, the Maidens of the Sea, some sailors, and the two deputy hosts, participating in the sea sacrificial segment for the first time, were terror‐stricken by the ominous scene, their faces paling.
target: Praefectus Maris, puellae Maris, quidam nautae, atque duo hospites vicarii, primum in sacrificio maritimo participantes, territi sunt a scena minaci, atque vultus eorum pallidi facti sunt.

source: For Juan Oro, a veteran of many sea sacrifices, it seemed like he was observing a child’s plaything.
target: Pro Juan Oro, veterano multorum sacrificiorum maritimorum, quasi lusum puerile observare videbatur.

source: He directed the sailors with no emotional fluctuations, guiding the ship along the only safe sea route through the thick fog and exaggerated waves.
target: Nautas, sine fluctuatione animi, imperavit; navem duxit per unicam viam maritimam tutam, per densam nebulam et undas amplificatas.

source: After an unknown duration, the fog lifted, and the tidal waves miraculously subsided.
target: Post tempus ignotum, nebula sublata est, et undae aestuosae mirabiliter remissae sunt.

source: An ocean resembling sapphires unfolded before Lumian’s eyes.
target: Oceanus, sapphiro similis, in conspectu Lumiani se explicavit.

source: The sea appeared limitless, but the distance and sky were gray, with only a hint of sunlight seeping through.
target: Mare interminabile apparuit, sed distantia et caelum cinereum erant, cum solis lumen modicum pertransiens.

source: Port Santa, Solow Motel.
target: Portus Santa, Solow Motel.

source: Lugano stood by the window, observing as the citizens formed celebratory teams, weaving through streets and alleys, spreading their joy.
target: Lugano ad fenestram stetit, observans cives turmas celebratorias formare, per vias et angustos intervalla ambulantes, laetitiam diffundentes.

source: Having already taken Ludwig to witness the Governor of the Sea’s colorful flower boat ritual and participated in two spontaneous citizen‐led celebrations, Lugano returned to the suite as teatime approached.
target: Iam Ludwig ducens ad videndum ritum navis florum coloratorum Praefecti Maris, et in duabus celebrationibus civium spontaneis participans, Lugano ad conclave rediit, dum tempus teae appropinquabat.

source: There, he provided Ludwig with food he had purchased and prepared in advance.
target: Ibi Ludwig cibum, quem antea emerat et praeparaverat, suppeditavit.

source: I could still head out later.
target: Postea adhuc exire potero.

source: When the Governor of the Sea returns, another wave of celebrations will ensue.
target: Cum Praefectus Maris redierit, alia unda celebrationum sequetur.

source: Unfortunately, I can’t engage with the enthusiastic Feynapotter girls with such a child in tow… Lugano thought regretfully.
target: Infeliciter, non possum implicari cum puellis Feynapotter ardentibus, habenti tale puerum… Lugano tristiter cogitavit.

source: At that moment, a knock echoed on the door.
target: Illo momento, pulsus ad ianuam resonavit.

source: “Who is it?”
target: “Quis est?”

source: Lugano, a seasoned bounty hunter, heightened his guard.
target: Lugano, venator peritus praedae, cautelam suam auget.

source: “It’s me.”
target: “Ego sum.”

source: A gentle voice emanated from outside the door.
target: Vox mitis extra ianuam effulsit.

source: Lugano recognized her as Rubió Paco’s wife, Madame Giorgia.
target: Lugano eam agnovit ut uxorem Rubió Paco, Domina Giorgia.

source: She’s here to see the boss?
target: Adestne ut dominum videat?

source: Has something happened to the Paco family again?
target: Numquid alia res accidit familiae Paco?

source: Lugano glanced at Ludwig, who was eating earnestly, and quickly walked to the door and opened it.
target: Lugano adspicuit Ludovicum, qui studiosus edebat, et celeriter ad ianuam processit eamque aperuit.

source: Giorgia, not clad in her usual glamorous attire, wore a black dress akin to that of an old widowed matriarch.
target: Giorgia, non induta habitu suo solito magnifico, sed veste atra, similis matrona vidua antiqua, erat.

source: Her long, disheveled brown hair was in disarray, and her thick azure eyes betrayed an unmistakable fear and panic.
target: Capilli eius longi et inconditi fusci erant dissoluti, et oculi eius densi caerulei timorem et metum manifestum prodiderunt.

source: “Where’s Monsieur Louis Berry?” the lady inquired.
target: “Ubi est Domine Louis Berry?” inquit illa.

source: “He’s participating in various celebrations for the sea prayer ritual,” Lugano fabricated an excuse.
target: “Ille in variis celebrationibus pro ritu orationis maritimae participat,” Lugano excusationem fingi conatus est.

source: He observed the distressed Madame Giorgia and instinctively inquired with concern, “Did something happen?”
target: Illam Dominam Giorgiam affectam observavit, et instinctive cum sollicitudine percontatus est, “Acciditne aliquid?”

source: Giorgia stammered, panic and fear evident in her eyes.
target: Giorgia balbutivit, cum metu et panico manifestis in oculis suis.

source: “I discovered the true identity of that humanoid lizard!”
target: “Veram identitatem illius lacertae humanoidis detexi!”

source: That humanoid lizard? The one the boss killed?
target: Illam lacertam humanoidem? Illam, quam dominus occidit?

source: Amidst Lugano’s confusion, Giorgia suddenly threw herself into his arms.
target: In medio confusionis Lugani, Giorgia subito se in eius bracchia iacuit.

source: The fragrance permeated Lugano’s senses, momentarily hindering him from immediately pushing the madam away.
target: Fragrans odor sensibus Lumiani pervadit, eum per momentum impediens ne eam statim repuleret.

source: Giorgia suppressed her voice but couldn’t conceal her fear.
target: Giorgia vocem repressit, sed timorem suum non potuit celare.

source: “That humanoid lizard was my husband, Rubió Paco!”
target: “Illo lacerta humanoide erat maritus meus, Rubió Paco!”

source: “Huh?”
target: “Heu?”

source: Lugano was both surprised and bewildered.
target: Lugano et obstupefactus et attonitus erat.

source: Giorgia gritted her teeth and explained, “The one you guys saw, it’s fake!”
target: Giorgia dentes strinxit et explicavit, “Illum quem vidistis, falsum est!”

source: Fake?
target: Falsum?

source: Someone impersonated Rubió Paco, and the real Rubió Paco had transformed into a humanoid lizard, killed by the boss?
target: Aliquis Rubió Paco impersonatus est, et verus Rubió Paco in lacertam humanoidem conversus, a domino occisus est?

source: As this realization struck Lugano, his thoughts suddenly slowed down.
target: Cum haec ratio Lugani percussit, cogitationes eius subito retardatae sunt.

source: The surroundings seemed coated in a glass‐like layer.
target: Circumiecta videbantur quasi in strato vitreo obtecta.

source: He instinctively struggled, but Giorgia held him tightly, interrupting him with various subtle actions.
target: Eum naturali impulsu certabat, sed Giorgia eum arcte tenuit, variis subtilibus actionibus eum interrumpens.

source: Ludwig, engrossed in devouring a skewer of roasted octopuses at the dining table, appeared oblivious to the unfolding silent drama at the door.
target: Ludwig, in devorando acus octopodum assorum ad mensam occupatus, obliviscens apparuit de silentio dramatis scaenam ad ianuam evolutam.

source: In a suite diagonally across the corridor, Rubió Paco sat quietly in a recliner, wearing a faint smile.
target: In conclavi diagonaliter trans coridorium, Rubió Paco quiete in lecto reclinato sedebat, levem risum gerens.

source: He had orchestrated the humanoid lizard incident and hired Louis Berry to resolve it intentionally.
target: Illum casum lacertae humanoidae praeordinaverat et Ludovicum Berry conductum habuit ut id propositum dirimeret.

source: Firstly, he aimed to confirm the other party’s identity.
target: Primum, propositum erat identitatem alterius confirmare.

source: Secondly, he wanted to leave a vulnerability in the Paco family’s handling of weak monsters, ensuring others wouldn’t suspect a Faceless’s involvement to confuse the target.
target: Secundo, volebat relinquere vulnerabilitatem in modo tractandi familiae Paco monstrorum infirmorum, curans ut ceteri non suspicaret interventionem alicuius "sine facie" ad scopum confundendum.

source: However, he abandoned the plan to deal with Louis Berry and refrained from triggering the corresponding trap.
target: Tamen consilium de tractando Ludovico Berry derelinquit et a excitando insidias pertinentes abstinuit.

source: This decision wasn’t due to uncertainty about the target’s identity; the Mysteries aura on Lumian Lee’s chest couldn’t escape his notice.
target: Haec decisio non ex incertitudine de identitate scopi facta fuit; aura Mysteriorum in pectore Lumiani Lee non effugere potuit eius animadversioni.

source: He was unlike others.
target: Ille aliis differebat.

source: Instead, he had a new plan.
target: Contra, novum consilium habebat.

source: The overall April Fool’s operation might not align with Loki’s personal objectives!
target: Universa operatio Aprilis Stultorum fortasse non congruet cum propositis personalibus Loki!

source: His current focus shifted to the young boy, Ludwig.
target: Focus eius nunc ad puerum iuvenem, Ludwig, convertebatur.

source: To him, a sealed demigod‐level powerhouse was a gift from the Celestial Worthy!
target: Ei, vis semidei clausae, donum a Caelestibus Dignis, videbatur.

source: No ritualistic target could be more suitable.
target: Nullus scopus ritualis magis aptus esse potuit.

source: Hence, he hinted at the sea anomaly, simultaneously confusing Lumian Lee and allowing him to connect the concepts of sealing and theft, understanding what occurred during last year’s prank.
target: Ergo, innuit de anomalía maris, simul Lumian Lee confundens et concedens ei notionem sigillandi atque furtum coniungere, intellegens quid anno praeterito in ludibrio actum fuerat.

source: He took the initiative to board the ship and head to the sea sacrifice grounds, enticing this formidable opponent away while another force restrained him.
target: Initiativam cepit ad navem conscindendam et ad loca sacrificii maritimi iter facere, hunc hostem formidolosum alliciens, dum alia copia eum retinebat.

source: Now, he was ready to execute a grand performance, captivating the attention of numerous Port Santa citizens!
target: Nunc paratus erat ut magnam spectaculum exsequeretur, multorum civium Portus Santa attentionem arripiens!

source: The calm, gem‐like sea held no waves.
target: Mare placidum, quasi gemma, fluctus non habebat.

source: The four Maidens of the Sea engaged in a brief sacrificial dance, while sailors carried offerings—lambs, roosters, ox heads, and more—from the cabin, stacking them at the bow.
target: Quattuor puellae Maris in brevi saltatione sacrificatoria versabantur, dum nautae oblationes portabant—agnos, gallos, capita bos, et alia—ex cella ad proram congregantes.

source: With the Ring of the Sea Queen in hand, Juan Oro approached the Governor of the Sea, awaiting the groom’s gift for the proposed marriage.
target: Cum Anulo Reginæ Maris in manu, Juan Oro Praefectum Maris appropinquavit, dona sponsi pro nuptiis proposita exspectans.

source: Lumian, vigilant of everyone present, scanned his surroundings.
target: Lumian, omnes praesentes vigilant, circumiecta perlustavit.

source: Any one of them could suddenly reveal themselves as Bard, Mad Lady, Ultraman, Loki, Hisoka, or a marionette.
target: Quisquis eorum subito se manifestare posset ut Bard, Mad Lady, Ultraman, Loki, Hisoka, aut marionetta.

source: The gentle, rhythmic dance concluded swiftly.
target: Saltatio mitis et rhythmica statim confecta est.

source: Juan Oro produced the peculiar golden ring, passing it to the incumbent Governor of the Sea, Simon Guiaro.
target: Juan Oro anulum aureum insuetus prodidit, illud Praefecto Maris hodierno, Simone Guiaro, tradens.

source: At that moment, a person emerged openly from the cabin.
target: Illo momento, unus homo ex cella palam emersit.

source: A woman in a black nun’s uniform and matching hat, her expression calm yet tinged with sadness.
target: Femina in uniforme monialis nigro et pileo congruenti, vultu tranquillo sed tristitia tincto, erat.

source: The surrounding sailors paid her no heed, as if she were invisible.
target: Nautae circumstantēs eam non curaverunt, quasi invisa esset.

source: Seeing this, Lumian’s pupils dilated, then constricted.
target: Hoc videns, pupillae Lumiani dilatatae, dein contractae sunt.

source: It was the source of Derangement!
target: Fons perturbationis erat!

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact lost by the Eternal Blazing Sun Church!
target: Artefactum sigillatum humanoide, a Ecclesia Solis Aeterni Flammei amissum!

source: In an instant, Lumian comprehended two things.
target: In momento, Lumian duas res intellexit.

source: The Death Navigators, transformed Governors of the Sea, had coincidentally appeared near the Flying Bird, stirring colossal waves.
target: Nāvīgātōrēs Mortis, Praefecti Maris mutati, casu apparuerunt prope Aves Volantem, undas colossales agitantēs.

source: The humanoid Sealed Artifact had unconsciously set out to sea, coincidentally choosing the same destination as him—Port Santa.
target: Artefactum sigillatum humanoide inconscius in mare profectum erat, casu eundum ad eundem destinatum ut ipse—Portus Santa—eligens.

source: There was a purpose behind this!
target: Hoc re propositum erat!
